reason: The saving is too small to matter, and the reuse would show a stale state at exactly the moment the state is expected to change. (1) The staleness proxy is wrong. The user ticks finals in the Kaggle web UI, and that produces no chat message. The 12:37Z re-tick to P3 was found by an API SELECTED read (read_selected.py), not from chat. So 'no chat message since' does not mean 'SELECTED unchanged'. (2) The T message itself tells the user to untick and tick in several cases: T1/T2/T3 promotion (a)/(b)/(c) 'снимите exp87a, отметьте exp89t', T4(c), and T7(c)/(d) 'Отметьте уже сейчас П3'. The 18:37Z check exists to verify that action (R39-A4 comparator). A pre-T read reused 8-15 min later would print 'Сейчас отмечены (API, ...)' with the pre-action pair on card l.7. It would then push untick/tick steps against a state the user may already have changed. That risks a confused user who unticks the correct new file or ends at 1 of 2 selected before 23:00 MSK. (3) The premise that the quiet window forbids the call is false. R39-A6 (2) explicitly allows 'the registered SELECTED reads' in 17:30-20:00Z. The window has about 30 poller calls (every 5 min) plus saves, so one read-only call spaced at least 8 min from the T read is about 3% of the load and has no bearing on 429/ban risk. (4) The change adds a conditional branch to the pre-registered R38-A5 (0) procedure at the busiest minute of the day, for 0 private or public score value. The T read comes at 18:17-18:29Z and the card at 18:37Z, so the 15-min branch would fire only sometimes, which adds another thing to get wrong.
fix: Do not adopt. Keep R38-A5 (0) as logged: 1 fresh read-only SELECTED call (read_selected.py) before each message, including the 18:37Z card. If load reduction is still wanted, the only defensible narrowing would be this: reuse the read only when the T message asked for no tick change, meaning SELECTED already passed R39-A4 against the post-T V_pub. Even then the saving is 1 call, so the recommendation is no change.
realistic_gain: About 0: one read-only API call saved (~3% of the 17:30-20:00Z window's calls), no effect on the public or private score. The downside is a possible stale finals-selection message right after the user was asked to re-tick.
